description:
rnews_config.rs:87–258 is a near-verbatim copy of pipeline.rs:241–408. Both functions dispatch on BackendType over the same 11 arms with identical logic. Every future backend addition or bug fix must be made in both places.

Suggested approach: refactor pipeline.rs so build_store accepts &Option<BackendConfig> and a fallback legacy &IpfsConfig (or a small trait/wrapper), then have build_store_for_rnews delegate to it. Alternatively, extract the BackendConfig dispatch into a free function build_store_from_backend(backend: &BackendConfig) -> Result<StoreBuildResult, String> in pipeline.rs and call it from both sites. The rnews variant only differs in the Ipfs fallback path (config.ipfs.api_url is required in full Config but Optional in RnewsConfig) — that small difference does not justify 170 lines of duplication.
title: build_store_for_rnews duplicates build_store
